measurement.evidence_span: The second sharper endothermic peak (2) appears at around 250 - 365 ^∘C, accompanied by a weight loss of 26 wt.%. This peak is attributed to the thermal decomposition of the mixed carbonates. A considerable amount of CO2 is liberated continuously in this stage which constituted to the major total weight loss.
